title: B-47 Ridge Designation Act
official_summary:
B-47 Ridge Designation Act

This bill designates the mountain ridge that runs south and west of Emigrant Peak in the Absaroka Range in Montana, which is where an Air Force B-47 strategic bomber crashed while on a training mission in 1962, as the "B-47 Ridge."

The bill permits the installing of a plaque on the ridge in memory of such crash.

summary.headline: A 2020 law names a Montana mountain ridge the "B-47 Ridge" to honor an Air Force bomber crash and allows a memorial plaque.
summary.what_it_does: The law designates the mountain ridge south and west of Emigrant Peak in Montana's Absaroka Range as the "B-47 Ridge." The ridge is where an Air Force B-47 bomber crashed during a 1962 training mission. The law also allows a plaque to be installed on the ridge in memory of the crash.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on October 13, 2020.
